fps_limit.label: FPS limit
fps_limit.description: Animation refresh rate (30-120). Higher = smoother, more CPU.

max_chars.label: Max line length
max_chars.description: Maximum characters before scrolling (10-80). Longer lines scroll right-to-left once the highlight reaches the visible middle.

active_color.label: Active color
active_color.description: Color role (primary, on_surface, #rrggbb) for sung text.

player.label: Target player
player.description: Player name for playerctl/lrc_tty (e.g. spotify, mpv). Empty = pick automatically among all players.

hide_when_paused.label: Hide when paused
hide_when_paused.description: Show nothing when playback is paused.

intro_gap_ms.label: Intro gap threshold
intro_gap_ms.description: Show ♪ ♪ ♪ from track start if lyrics begin later than this (ms).

interlude_text.label: Interlude text
interlude_text.description: Symbols shown during empty lyric lines and intros.
